objective: Choose preparation work by cross-route leverage: build one shared object when it unlocks many routes, then spend custom effort only on irreducible route deltas.

preparation_order.title: Canonical Facts + Evidence Spine
preparation_order.why_high_roi: Every CV, resume, SOP, research statement, faculty email, recommender brief, project sheet, application bio and interview answer should derive from the same facts and evidence rather than being rewritten independently.
preparation_order.done_when: All outward-facing packet families can be generated without inventing a fact or reopening basic portfolio history.

preparation_order.title: PhD Core Dossier
preparation_order.coverage: Reusable source for 61/61 PhD routes; exact program requirements remain route deltas
contains: thesis / research-object placeholder with no asset mapping until user authority exists

preparation_order.title: Recommender + Official Document Pack
preparation_order.coverage: Shared dependency across the PhD campaign; exact recommendation/document requirements still need per-route hydration
preparation_order.why_high_roi: It attacks the critical-path work that depends on other people and institutional documents, especially during the Sep-Oct doctoral deadline cluster.

preparation_order.title: Five Employment Packet Families
preparation_order.coverage: 88/88 employment routes must map to one family or explicit identity gap
route_specific_delta: optional cover note only when useful

preparation_order.title: Canonical Evidence Cards
preparation_order.coverage: Reusable across PhD, faculty, job and interview packets where the asset is relevant

preparation_order.title: 149-Route Delta Matrix
preparation_order.integrity_rule: The two unresolved employment identities stay IDENTITY_GAP until source-locked; never invent route rows to force 88 named entries.

preparation_order.title: Interview / Oral Exam Story Bank
preparation_order.coverage: Reusable after applications begin converting to interviews/orals
stories: thesis / research object only after user authority exists

do_not_do_first: build route-specific packets before the shared evidence spine exists
polish low-value secondary papers merely because a venue exists
prepare interview material before application packets are operational unless an interview is already scheduled

first_execution_target.reason: Highest breadth of reuse across both terminal Main Quest campaigns and every downstream packet family.
first_execution_target.user_input_policy: Use existing repository/context evidence by default; ask the user only for factual corrections, unavailable official documents, or genuinely unresolved personal decisions.
